$comment: Known environment limits. The harness copies the matching block into run.json (environment.knownLimits) and marks friction events environment_limited when they match. Keep reasons short — they show up in reports.

local.summary: Local stack: this worktree's server + built web app, fresh seeded FileStore per run, no secrets, no worker.
knownLimits: Dining menus and RSF gym crowd levels need live campus sources (the local stack runs with CAMPUS_LIVE=0) — empty or missing data there is not a UX bug.
AI features (Ask Lumi, AI profile draft on /start, conversation starters) need an OpenAI key; none is configured locally.
Course catalog is the built-in sample list (~210 courses, typical times). Live has the real Berkeley Class Schedule from the data worker.
Opportunities are only the CSV rows in server/data (deadline calendar). Live also has worker-fetched internships (Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby), Devpost hackathons and CalLink/campus events.
No e-mail is sent: the sign-up / sign-in code is shown on screen in the hint (live sends a real e-mail).
Real-time updates (SSE) work locally; other people never reply unless the stack was started with --autoreply.

routes.reason: Dining/gym need live campus sources (CAMPUS_LIVE=0 locally).

requests.reason: AI endpoints need an OpenAI key (not configured locally).

contentCaveats.reason: Local stack has only CSV opportunities; live also has worker-fetched internships, hackathons and campus events — check on live before acting.
Local course catalog is the built-in sample list, not the real Berkeley schedule.

catalogBuiltin.reason: Local stack used the built-in sample course catalog (e.g. MATH 1A); live has the imported current-term Berkeley schedule (e.g. MATH 51), so course names and codes differ. Run `local-stack catalog fetch` and re-run.

local.$catalogComment: The 'Course catalog' knownLimits line is replaced per run by lib/session-server.mjs knownLimits(): real catalog (cached with `local-stack catalog fetch`) or built-in sample.
local.$eventsComment: The 'Opportunities are only the CSV rows' line and the community/discover caveat are replaced/dropped per run when the template has a live events snapshot (`local-stack events fetch`).

live.summary: Live production site with the ux-sim write guard: every mutating /api request except demo login and read-only calls is blocked and answered with 403.
knownLimits: Writes are blocked: signing up, joining, posting, saving, messaging, RSVPs, timetable edits and read-receipts all fail with a ux-sim guard error. Anything that breaks right after a blocked request is environment-limited.
The shared demo account (u_me) is used for signed-in scenarios; its data is sample data and may have been changed by other demo visitors.
AI endpoints are blocked (they cost money and are logged).

requests.reason: AI endpoints are blocked in live mode.

custom.summary: A --base-url on localhost that ux-sim did not start (e.g. your own dev server). No guard; assume a disposable store.
knownLimits: Unknown setup — record what you started and with which data.
